description:
Sold-out waitlist: join, position visibility, auto-offer with expiry when returns/releases/kills free inventory, offer cascade on decline/expiry. Rides on TKT-4 holds machinery; honors TKT-20 purchase limits.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Freed inventory triggers a time-boxed offer to the head of the waitlist; expiry cascades to the next
- Waitlist honors per-event purchase limits and account requirements
- Waitlist-to-purchase conversion is traceable end-to-end (ADR-003)
